title: Phishing against personnel
description: Staff targeted by credential harvesting emails. Successful attack gives attacker valid account access or installs malware.
treatment: Mitigate -- MFA enforced, phishing simulation training, AI-based email filtering

title: Ransomware via initial access
description: Attacker gains foothold via phishing or exposed service, moves laterally and deploys ransomware across operational systems.
treatment: Mitigate -- network segmentation, immutable backups, EDR, tested recovery procedure

title: Supply chain compromise
description: Malicious code delivered via a trusted software supplier update. Analogous to SolarWinds 2020 and XZ Utils 2024.
treatment: Mitigate -- supplier security assessments, SBOM requirement, staged update rollout

title: Insider threat -- data exfiltration
description: Personnel with legitimate access intentionally or negligently exfiltrate sensitive information.
treatment: Mitigate -- need-to-know access, periodic access reviews, DLP

title: Weak security requirements in supplier contracts
description: Some supplier contracts lack security clauses, data processing agreements and breach notification obligations.
treatment: Mitigate -- standard security clause library, annual supplier reviews

title: Insufficient logging and monitoring
description: Not all systems send logs to the SIEM. Alert rules are not tuned. Attacker could operate undetected.
treatment: Mitigate -- full log coverage audit, MITRE-mapped detection rules, MTTD measurement

title: Missing AI governance policy
description: Staff using LLMs for work without a policy. Risk of sensitive data being submitted to external AI services.
treatment: Mitigate -- draft AI usage policy aligned to ISO/IEC 42001:2023

title: Unencrypted laptops in field use
description: A subset of older laptops does not have full-disk encryption enforced. Lost device means readable data.
treatment: BitLocker enforced via MDM. Remote wipe in place. Residual risk accepted.
